reviews.comment: Love the color and look! Way more space to work with and still have plenty room and slots to add more components in the future.

reviews.title: Great smaller ATX fish tank case
reviews.comment: Its a great cade to work with that has plenty of cable management space for your build. Best thing to do will be to replace the fans it comes with since they are 3 pin and will be a little noisy.

reviews.title: Easy to build in and looks great!
reviews.comment: Roomy for a mid tower. Easy for cable management. Makes for a very clean build.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.comment: Aside from the clear panes, this case lets so much air flow keeping everything inside cool! The USB-C on the front is a nice addition; I put my SteelSeries headset receiver there for easy migration between my pc and PS5. I like the bottom part hides the power supply and cables as well as my Corsair governor.
